class.name: AcousticFlood
class.brief_description: Two-layer distance field flood over a grid of terrain cells, for sound propagation.
class.description: Floods a window of a baked grid of terrain cells from a set of seed cells, in two layers: paths that have gone through nothing yet (the around route) and paths that have gone through terrain that costs anything or a blocker (the through route). Terrain is passable at a cost scaled by the cell's weight, blockers (closed doors) at their own cost, charged once per full crossing. The caller keeps the grid and everything that reads the result; only the flood lives here, for speed.

method.name: flood
method.description: Floods the square window of [param window_side] cells a side whose top left grid cell is [param window_origin_cell], over a grid of [param row_length] by [param row_amount] cells given as one byte per cell in [param solid_cells] (non-zero for solid) and [param cell_weights] (0 to [constant WEIGHT_FULL], how much a solid cell costs to enter; empty counts every solid cell as full). Cells outside the grid are open air. The flood starts from [param seed_window_cells], in window cell coordinates, each at its distance from [param player_point], in continuous window cell coordinates. [param blocked_cells] are grid cells covered by blockers, each with a cost in [param blocked_costs] and an occlusion in [param blocked_occlusions] (0 to [constant BLOCKER_OCCLUSION_MASK]). [param costs] tunes the flood, in tenths of a cell: [code]cost_orthogonal[/code], [code]cost_diagonal[/code], [code]max_distance[/code], [code]material_cost[/code], [code]material_cost_max[/code], [code]blocker_cost_max[/code], [code]wall_cost[/code], [code]through_dominance_margin[/code] and [code]seal_prune_margin[/code]. Returns a dictionary of arrays over both layers, the around layer's cells first and the through layer's after them at an offset of the window's cell count: [code]distances[/code] and [code]parents[/code] (window layered indices, [constant UNREACHED] where the flood didn't get), [code]blocker_occlusions[/code] (one byte per cell, occlusion plus [constant BLOCKER_PENDING_BIT] mid-crossing), [code]material_costs[/code] and [code]surcharges[/code] (how much of the distance is material entered, and material plus blockers), and over the window's cells only, [code]window_solid[/code] and [code]window_opaque[/code] (solid, or solid or blocked).
